name: Sandhan Valley ("Valley of Shadows")
tagline: A narrow, deep Sahyadri canyon — rappelling and rock scrambling required
highlights: Narrow, deep Sahyadri canyon — the 'Valley of Shadows' lives up to its name in person.
Rappelling is mandatory, not optional — at least one significant rope section on the standard route.
Flash-flood risk in monsoon — water can rise fast inside the gorge even when it's clear overhead.
Short distance (~2 km traverse) but high technical demand — this is expert-grade, not a beginner canyon walk.
We do not recommend attempting this solo under any circumstances — book with a qualified local operator.

seoTitle: Sandhan Valley Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Sandhan Valley near Samrad — the narrow Sahyadri canyon trek with rappelling, flash-flood risk, and why you shouldn't attempt it alone.
dataNote: Sources disagree on the rappel height (~45 ft vs. up to ~120 ft cited) — likely reflects different sections/route variants. Confirm exact figures with your chosen operator's route notes rather than treating either number as fixed. The 'Grand Canyon of Maharashtra' comparison used in some marketing copy is colorful description, not a geological classification.

seasons.sub: Drier canyon floor, lower flash-flood risk

routeOptions.name: Full canyon traverse from Samrad
routeOptions.duration: ~5 hrs including rappelling and water crossings
routeOptions.notes: Narrow crevices, rock scrambling, and at least one rappel section. Professional rappelling gear and a trained guide are strongly recommended — this is not a casual scramble.

safety.intro: Sandhan Valley is one of the more technical, genuinely dangerous entries on this list — a narrow, deep gorge with real flash-flood risk in monsoon and mandatory rappelling.

alerts.title: Flash-flood risk inside the canyon
alerts.body: The valley is a narrow, deep gorge — water can rise fast and with little warning during heavy rain upstream, even if it's not raining directly overhead. Avoid attempting this in monsoon unless with an experienced operator actively monitoring conditions.

alerts.title: Rappelling required — not optional
alerts.body: At least one significant rappel section is part of the standard route. Do not attempt without proper harness/rope gear and a qualified guide, regardless of your general trekking experience.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Book with an established local operator who provides rappelling gear and a trained guide
Avoid monsoon season entirely unless your operator is confident about conditions that specific day
Confirm group size — this isn't a trek to do with just one inexperienced partner

cards.title: On the trail
items: Follow the guide's rope/harness instructions exactly
Watch for sudden changes in water flow or sound (a sign of upstream rain) and exit if instructed
Pace the group to the slowest member on scrambling sections

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: We do not recommend attempting Sandhan Valley solo under any circumstances — go with a guided group
If you arrive without a booked group, do not attempt to freelance the rappel sections alone

items.name: Grippy water-shoes or trekking shoes rated for wet rock
